clo_details: Gain a comprehensive understanding of fundamental principles in image and video processing, digital signal processing in time domain and frequency domain
Develop expertise in applying the tradditional and machine learning-based techniques for image and video acquisition, digitization, enhancement, restoration.
Develop expertise in applying traditional and machine learning based methods to compress images and video
Acquire practical skills by using and implementing traditional and machine learning based tools to segment and extract features of an image
Develop expertise in applying traditional and machine learning based methods in object detection, motion estimation and video analysis.
